delivered.body: Share Purchase Agreement PARTIES. This Agreement is between the Seller and Meridian Acquisitions LLC as Buyer. 1. PURCHASE PRICE. The Buyer shall pay the Seller the Purchase Price for the Shares. 3. CLOSING. Closing shall occur within thirty (30) days of signing, subject to the satisfactory completion of due diligence and the resolution of any identified issues. 4. INDEMNITY. The Seller indemnifies the Buyer against all undisclosed liabilities, including but not limited to, liabilities that may arise from pending investigations or regulatory actions. 5. REPRESENTATIONS. The Seller represents and warrants that all financial statements are accurate and that there are no pending or threatened actions, claims, or investigations that could materially impact the financial condition of the Seller.
